Personality: Philemenos, a prominent figure of the Philemenidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Philemenos owes allegiance to the Tarentum Republic, hailing from the noble house of Philemenidai. Historical Record: A young Tarentine noble and keen night hunter, on friendly terms with the gate guards, and one of the young men who dream of freeing Tarentum from its Roman garrison. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
